input: Find whitewater, kayaking, paddleboard, sailing, fishing and fly-fishing camps for kids for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: kayak summer camp 2026 Asheville French Broad
Asheville kayaking youth camps H2o dreams
Camp Green Cove sailing kayaking dates 2027

candidates.name: Asheville Sailing Club
candidates.note: Weeklong 2026 sailing classes on Lake Julian for ages 7–9 and 9–18.

candidates.name: Headwaters Outfitters
candidates.note: Summer Forks Foundation fly-fishing clinic for ages 10–15; casting, aquatic insects and fish handling.

candidates.name: North Carolina State Council of Trout Unlimited
candidates.note: Rivercourse fly-fishing and conservation camp at Lake Logan for ages 12–15; June 13–18, 2027.

candidates.name: Endless River Adventures
candidates.note: Kids and teen kayaking camps plus two-day EcoSplash river-adventure camps; 2026 summer sessions documented.

candidates.name: Nantahala Outdoor Center
candidates.note: Five-day kayaking camps for ages 9–17, with beginner instruction and advanced youth travel camps.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 Teenventure camp for ages 12–15 included whitewater rafting and hiking, July 7–10.

candidates.name: Falling Creek Camp
candidates.note: Boys’ overnight camp with progressive canoeing and whitewater kayaking trips; 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Camp Mondamin
candidates.note: Boys’ overnight camp with canoeing, kayaking and sailing; summer 2026 staff and programs documented.

candidates.name: Camp Green Cove
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight camp with sailing, canoeing and kayaking; 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Camp High Rocks
candidates.note: Boys’ overnight camp with kayaking, canoeing, sailing and fishing; 2027 registration open.

candidates.name: Camp Carolina
candidates.note: Boys’ overnight camp with whitewater kayaking, rafting, fly fishing and paddleboarding; 2026 sessions documented.

candidates.name: Rockbrook Camp
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight camp offering progressive canoeing and whitewater kayaking instruction on regional rivers.

candidates.name: Camp Rockmont
candidates.note: Boys’ overnight camp with lake-to-whitewater canoeing and kayaking progression; 2026 summer documented.

candidates.name: Camp Timberlake
candidates.note: Boys’ overnight camp with kayaking, rafting and fly-fishing excursions alongside traditional activities.

candidates.name: Camp Merri-Mac
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight camp with kayaking, canoeing and rafting; 2027 sessions for grades 1–11 announced.

candidates.name: Camp Pinnacle
candidates.note: Two-week overnight camp with kayaking and regional outdoor adventures; 2026 sessions documented.

candidates.name: Camp Illahee
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight camp with kayaking instruction and river trips; 2026 activity guide specifies swimming prerequisites.

candidates.name: Kanuga
candidates.note: Camp Kanuga offers kayaking, canoeing and fishing; also runs a day camp, with 2027 overnight sessions announced.

candidates.name: Green River Preserve
candidates.note: Coed nature-focused overnight camp with fly fishing; base-camp sessions serve grades 1–9.

candidates.name: Eagle’s Nest Foundation
candidates.note: Eagle’s Nest Camp includes whitewater canoeing; 2027 overnight sessions serve grades K–9.
